description: Lets the Properties windows name the application that opens a file (the file types plugin's status and handlers, to read only) for the Opens with row, read the system's 12/24-hour clock setting so their dates are shown the way the rest of the app shows them, and read the settings (only read: the Shelf window's permission) so they draw in the person's look: the icon set, the colours, the density and the transparency, like every other window. They may not open files with an application, change a default or change a setting.
